# teleoperator-mcp

WebXR teleoperation gateway for the MCP fleet. VR headset (Pico 4) streams pose via WebSocket; Python maps to robot drivers (yahboom-mcp first). MCP tools handle session config and status — not the 30 Hz pose hot path.

- PRD: docs/PRD.md
- Dual-mode arc: docs/DUAL_MODE_ARCHITECTURE.md
- Plan: docs/TODO.md
- HTTPS: docs/HTTPS.md
- Bring-up: docs/BRINGUP.md
- Stack: docs/STACK.md
- Ports: webapp 10900, backend 10901 (WebSocket + REST + MCP HTTP)
